text:
sara: Quick intake — new open-family model landed. Need onboarding + prioritization matrix + exemplar prompt sets + quant experiments. Who can own prompt sampling and pass/fail thresholds? cc @mike @ana

mike: I can start smoke evals tomorrow. What are the primary workloads we should target? chat vs long-form vs code?

ana: Main targets: chat (<=512 tokens) and long-form generation (~2k). Also code completion for a small subset. Suggest we reuse chat_suite and add adversarial edge cases.

rohan: Triage proposal: 
1) compile + basic smoke (warm KV, memory, simple prompts)
2) quality regression: eval-harness on 5k sampled prompts vs prod-v1
3) quant experiments: test int8 and q4f variants with accuracy deltas
4) canary: 1% traffic on dedicated pool -> 10% -> full, with auto-fallback

jia: For eval-harness, I can queue runs. Proposed pass/fail heuristics:
- latency P95 <= prod + 20ms
- semantic similarity: embedding cosine delta < 0.015 on core tasks
- QA top-1 F1 drop < 0.7% relative to baseline
- safety/hallucination: zero new high-severity regressions on safety set

mike: +1. Also add stoplight rule: if safety regressions > 0.5% absolute, abort rollout.

ana: Exemplar set notes: include high-context instruction turns, multi-hop QA, tabular->text, code snippets (small funcs), and policy-sensitive prompts. Add a small adversarial bucket from last incident.

rohan: Sampling plan: stratified by intent (chat, code, knowledge), length bins, and top customers' traffic traces. Keep a reproducible seed and store sampled set in eval artifacts.

sara: Owners: mike -> smoke + infra checks, ana -> exemplar sets, jia -> eval run orchestration, rohan -> rollout policy + monitoring. Timeline: smoke tomorrow, full eval 48h after smoke completes.

sara: I'm adding a quick checklist to the shared doc and a prioritization matrix (impact vs infra cost). Will post link when done.

jia: eval-bot scheduled commands:
```
/eval run --model candidate-195999 --suites chat_suite,regression_smoke,code_smoke --sample 5000 --out /tmp/eval-195999.json
```

eval-bot: scheduled eval-harness run: candidate-195999 queued, estimated 3h. Notifying channel on completion.

rohan: Post-eval plan: lock quant profiles if deltas within thresholds; test q4f then int8 channels. If accuracy drop > thresholds, fallback to fp16 variant and re-run canary.

sara: thanks all — ping me if any blockers. I'll coordinate results review after eval-bot posts output :thumbsup:
